name: Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefit_amount: Up to 35% Capital Subsidy (₹17.5 Lakh max subsidy)
benefit_summary: Government capital subsidy (Margin Money) of 15% to 35% on bank-financed micro-enterprises up to ₹50 Lakhs (Manufacturing) or ₹20 Lakhs (Services).
who_can_apply_intro: All eligible citizens who meet the Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) guidelines.
application_steps: Check that your Aadhaar card and active bank passbook are ready.
Visit the official portal or your local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Panchayat office.
Fill in the application details and complete your biometric or OTP e-KYC.
Receive your application reference number to track verification and direct payment status.
